description: Verify accepted Lab self-tests, Code Mode, reusable workflows, Gen-4 workflow graphs, LKG equality, and containment after an MCP update.
name: lab-post-update-verify

steps.command:
python3 - <<'PY2'
import hashlib,json,pathlib
b=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/etc/optiplex-lab/build.json').read_text()); h=hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/opt/optiplex-lab/server.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(); assert b.get('recovery_state')=='ACCEPTED'; assert b.get('source_sha256')==h; assert b.get('last_known_good_sha256')==h; print('ACCEPTED_BUILD_OK',h)
PY2
